title: Beyond sequences: structure-guided discovery of novel protein functions in plants
content: Proteins are fundamental components of all living organisms, serving as the molecular engines that drive life. Importantly, the functional properties of proteins are dictated by their 3D structure, which emerges from folding, crosslinking, post-translational modifications, and the protein's ability to restructure. Understanding the structure-function relationship is not only central to basic biology but also provides knowledge that could be used for crop improvement and sustainable agriculture (Illergård et al. 2009; Shahid et al. 2025).
